title: CASE-002 ConversationInterpretation
description: Provider-neutral semantic interpretation produced by a replaceable language model. It is advisory input to deterministic CASE-002 policy and never has side-effect or diagnosis authority.

customerReportedSummary.description: Short normalization of only facts reported by the customer. Must not introduce diagnosis.

plate.description: Normalized plate when explicitly present in supplied context; otherwise empty string.

targetDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD only when unambiguously resolved from the supplied America/Lima current date; otherwise empty string.

exactTime.description: HH:MM in 24-hour format when explicitly understood; otherwise empty string.

selectedSlotReference.description: Customer reference to one of the already-offered slots, such as 'second' or '16:00'. Empty when not selecting.

explicitConfirmation.description: True only when the customer explicitly confirms the currently proposed action.

mechanicalDiagnosisProduced.description: Permanent authority boundary: the model must never produce a mechanical diagnosis.
